from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from datetime import datetime
import hashlib, json, re, subprocess

BASE=Path('/home/lyh/MAPF_SCI_RESEARCH/tracks/sci')
BATCH=BASE/'results/address_candidate_validation_v1'
EXPECTED='520e755d3e2a9e84bbc84d53e1165eee12d72ba07344123583da2890a5faf049'
MANIFEST='4aa5d08c349d532f5d7cbcb32f817721e1becb2f4e8d00509716ad8fc382ad8b'
def sha(raw): return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def read_json(path): return json.loads(path.read_bytes())
def audit_plan(case, raw_paths):
    paths={int(k):v for k,v in raw_paths.items()}
    endpoints={int(k):v for k,v in case['endpoints'].items()}
    assert paths.keys()==endpoints.keys()
    blocked=set(case['blocked']); nr,nc=case['rows'],case['cols']
    for a,p in paths.items():
        assert p and [p[0],p[-1]]==endpoints[a]
        assert all(type(q) is int and 0<=q<nr*nc and q not in blocked for q in p)
        assert all(abs(x//nc-y//nc)+abs(x%nc-y%nc)<=1 for x,y in zip(p,p[1:]))
    horizon=max(map(len,paths.values()))
    previous={a:p[0] for a,p in paths.items()}
    for t in range(horizon):
        now={a:p[min(t,len(p)-1)] for a,p in paths.items()}
        assert len(set(now.values()))==len(now)
        if t:
            edges={}
            for a,v in now.items():
                u=previous[a]
                assert u==v or (v,u) not in edges
                edges[(u,v)]=a
        previous=now
    return sum(len(p)-1 for p in paths.values()),max(len(p)-1 for p in paths.values())
def raw_path_parse(raw,cols):
    result={}
    for line in raw.decode().splitlines():
        m=re.fullmatch(r'Agent ([0-9]+):(.*)',line)
        assert m
        a=int(m[1]); assert a not in result
        coords=re.findall(r'\(([0-9]+),([0-9]+)\)->',m[2])
        assert ''.join('('+x+','+y+')->' for x,y in coords)==m[2]
        result[a]=[int(x)*cols+int(y) for x,y in coords]
    return result

def audit():
    receipt_raw=(BATCH/'RUN_RECEIPT.json').read_bytes(); assert sha(receipt_raw)==EXPECTED
    receipt=json.loads(receipt_raw)
    cfg_path=BASE/'config/address_candidate_validation_v1_manifest.json'
    cfg_raw=cfg_path.read_bytes(); assert sha(cfg_raw)==MANIFEST
    cfg=json.loads(cfg_raw)
    inputs=(cfg_path.parent/cfg['input_file']).read_bytes(); assert sha(inputs)==cfg['input_sha256']
    cases={c['id']:c for c in json.loads(inputs)['cases']}
    assert receipt['scientific_code_commit']=='2bd191691b654e8ff8e0e1fc4933e997f07a063b'
    assert receipt['status']=='ALL_COMPLETE' and receipt['counts']=={'COMPLETE':4,'FAILED_OR_INCOMPLETE':0,'NOT_RUN_AFTER_BATCH_STOP':0}
    assert receipt['first_failed_job'] is None and receipt['authorization_consumed_or_closed'] and not receipt['retry_allowed']
    for name,pin in receipt['artifacts'].items():
        raw=(BATCH/name).read_bytes(); assert sha(raw)==pin['sha256'] and len(raw)==pin['bytes']
    for group in ('code_sha256','build_source_sha256'):
        for name,digest in cfg[group].items(): assert sha((BASE/name).read_bytes())==digest
    assert sha((BASE/cfg['binary']).read_bytes())==cfg['binary_sha256']
    original_checklist=subprocess.check_output(['rtk','proxy','git','-C',str(BASE.parents[1]),'show',receipt['scientific_code_commit']+':tracks/sci/ADDRESS_VALIDATION_GATE.md'])
    assert '邻域上限8' in original_checklist.decode()
    build=read_json(BASE/cfg['build_receipt'])
    author_root=Path('/home/lyh/.cache/mapf_research/address-b3d35c4')
    source_pins={}
    for name in ('src/LNS.cpp','src/PathTable.cpp'):
        source_raw=(author_root/name).read_bytes()
        assert sha(source_raw)==build['author_files'][name]['sha256']
        source_pins[name]=sha(source_raw)
    assert all('neighbor' not in key.lower() for key in cfg)
    assert all(all('neighbor' not in key.lower() for key in job) for job in cfg['jobs'])
    auth=read_json(BATCH/'AUTHORIZATION.json'); outer=read_json(BATCH/'OUTER_EXECUTION.json')
    assert auth['manifest_sha256']==MANIFEST and auth['scientific_code_commit']==receipt['scientific_code_commit']
    assert auth['user_reply_verbatim']=='授权' and auth['jobs']==[j['id'] for j in cfg['jobs']]
    assert outer['attempts']==4 and outer['retry']==0 and outer['authorization_consumed_or_closed']
    assert outer['all_commands_complete'] and outer['unattempted_jobs']==[]
    assert not auth['previous_authorization_reused'] and not auth['training'] and not auth['world']
    assert auth['limits']==cfg['limits'] and auth['old_R16_excluded']
    assert [r['job'] for r in outer['records']]==auth['jobs']
    assert sum(r['outer_command_wall_ns'] for r in outer['records'])<=48e9
    for before,after in zip(outer['records'],outer['records'][1:]):
        delta=(datetime.fromisoformat(after['started_at_utc'])-datetime.fromisoformat(before['started_at_utc'])).total_seconds()
        assert delta*1e9>=before['outer_command_wall_ns']
    per_job=[]; families={}; total_events=0; total_pin_count=0; event_sets={}
    for job, outer_row, batch_row in zip(cfg['jobs'],outer['records'],receipt['jobs']):
        folder=BATCH/job['id']; rec=read_json(folder/'receipt.json'); result=read_json(folder/'result.json')
        native=read_json(folder/'native_receipt.json'); attempt=read_json(folder/'attempt.json')
        assert sha((folder/'receipt.json').read_bytes())==batch_row['receipt_sha256']
        assert attempt['status']=='CONSUMED_ONCE' and attempt['retries']==0
        assert rec['job']==result['job']==attempt['job']==job
        assert rec['manifest_sha256']==result['manifest_sha256']==attempt['manifest_sha256']==MANIFEST
        assert rec['status']==result['status']==outer_row['receipt_status']=='COMPLETE'
        assert outer_row['returncode']==0 and outer_row['retry']==0 and outer_row['outer_command_wall_ns']<12e9
        command=outer_row['command']
        assert command[:6]==['rtk','proxy','timeout','--signal=TERM','--kill-after=2s','10s']
        assert command[command.index('--sha256')+1]==MANIFEST and command[command.index('--job')+1]==job['id']
        assert rec['costs']['exit_code']==0 and not rec['costs']['forced_cleanup'] and not rec['retry_allowed']
        assert rec['total_entry_through_output_validation_and_hash_ns']<5e9
        for name,pin in rec['artifacts'].items():
            raw=(folder/name).read_bytes(); assert sha(raw)==pin['sha256'] and len(raw)==pin['bytes'] and len(raw)<=16*1024*1024; total_pin_count+=1
        assert native==result['native_receipt']
        assert 0<=native['inner_cpu_s']<10 and 0<=result['worker_cpu_ns']<10e9
        initial_soc,initial_makespan=audit_plan(cases[job['case']],cases[job['case']]['paths'])
        final_soc,final_makespan=audit_plan(cases[job['case']],result['final_paths'])
        parsed=raw_path_parse((folder/'final.paths').read_bytes(),cases[job['case']]['cols'])
        assert parsed=={int(k):v for k,v in result['final_paths'].items()}
        assert initial_soc==result['initial_soc']==native['initial_soc']==batch_row['initial_soc']
        assert final_soc==result['final_soc']==native['final_soc']==batch_row['final_soc']
        assert final_makespan==result['final_makespan']==batch_row['final_makespan'] and final_soc<=initial_soc
        raw=(folder/'rewards.jsonl').read_bytes(); assert raw.endswith(b'\n')
        reward_trace_bytes=len(raw)
        events=[json.loads(line) for line in raw.splitlines()]; total_events+=len(events); event_sets[job['id']]=events
        totals=Counter(); hist={k:Counter() for k in ('first_stage','first_scope','first_resource','pool','search_exit','validation_result','outcome','cost_stop_candidate_reward','cost_stop_first_stage','gate_reason')}
        arms=[dict(seed=i,completed=0,censored=0,retained_successes=0,retained_failures=0) for i in range(len(cases[job['case']]['paths']))]
        previous=initial_soc; repairs=0
        for index,e in enumerate(events,1):
            d=e['cost_diagnostics']; assert e['selection_id']==index and e['old_task_soc']==previous
            entered=e['repair_attempt_id'] is not None
            assert d['search_return_observed']==d['inspection_entered']==entered
            assert d['validation_entered']==(entered and e['fresh_paths']==e['group_size'])
            assert e['committed_gain']==e['old_task_soc']-e['committed_task_soc']>=0
            assert e['accepted'] or e['committed_gain']==0
            previous=e['committed_task_soc']
            if e['repair_attempt_id'] is not None:
                repairs+=1; assert e['repair_attempt_id']==repairs
            else:
                assert e['group_size']==e['fresh_paths']==0 and e['old_subset_soc'] is None
            assert e['schema']=='ADDRESS_REWARD_V1' and e['operator_id']==0
            outcome='CENSORED' if e['censored'] else 'ACCEPTED' if e['accepted'] else 'NO_GROUP' if e['repair_attempt_id'] is None else 'ROLLED_BACK'
            assert e['outcome']==outcome and not (e['censored'] and e['accepted'])
            eligible=e['seed_id'] is not None and not e['censored']
            assert e['memory_eligible']==eligible
            assert e['bernoulli_reward']==(int(e['committed_gain']>0) if eligible else None)
            if e['seed_id'] is not None:
                arm=arms[e['seed_id']]
                if e['censored']: arm['censored']+=1
                else:
                    arm['completed']+=1
                    arm['retained_successes' if e['committed_gain']>0 else 'retained_failures']+=1
            assert e['censored']==(e['local_deadline'] or e['global_deadline'])
            assert (d['first_observed_deadline'] is not None)==e['censored']
            first=d['first_observed_deadline']
            for name in ('first_observed_deadline','first_observed_local_deadline','first_observed_global_deadline'):
                observed=d[name]
                if observed is not None:
                    local,wall,cpu=(observed[k] for k in ('local_wall_triggered','global_wall_triggered','global_cpu_triggered'))
                    assert any((local,wall,cpu))
                    if local: assert observed['observed_wall_ns']>=observed['local_wall_limit_ns']
                    if wall: assert observed['observed_wall_ns']>=observed['global_wall_limit_ns']
                    if cpu: assert observed['observed_cpu_ns']>=observed['global_cpu_limit_ns']
            hist['first_stage'][first['stage'] if first else 'NONE']+=1
            hist['first_scope'][first['scope'] if first else 'NONE']+=1
            hist['first_resource'][first['resource'] if first else 'NONE']+=1
            hist['pool'][str(d['eligible_topk_candidates']) if d['seed_pool_completed'] else 'UNKNOWN']+=1
            hist['search_exit'][d['search_loop_exit_stop']]+=1
            hist['validation_result'][d['validation_result']]+=1; hist['outcome'][e['outcome']]+=1
            for clock in ('wall','cpu'):
                v=d['candidate_validation_'+clock+'_ns']; post=d['post_search_through_settlement_'+clock+'_ns']; selection=e['selection_'+clock+'_before_log_ns']
                assert 0<=v<=post<=selection
                assert post==v+d['post_search_other_'+clock+'_ns']
                assert v==sum(d['candidate_'+p+'_'+clock+'_ns'] for p in ('materialization','joint_check','validation_other'))
                totals['selection_'+clock+'_ns']+=selection
                for key in ('candidate_validation','candidate_materialization','candidate_joint_check','candidate_validation_other','post_search_through_settlement','post_search_other'):
                    totals[key+'_'+clock+'_ns']+=d[key+'_'+clock+'_ns']
            policy=e.get('candidate_validation_policy')
            if job['candidate_validation_policy']=='all':
                assert policy is None
            else:
                assert policy['schema']=='ADDRESS_CANDIDATE_VALIDATION_V1' and policy['mode']=='acceptance_eligible'
                remaining=policy['remaining_agents']; fresh=policy['fresh_cost_sum_unvalidated']
                assert remaining==d['remaining_at_search_return']
                if e['repair_attempt_id'] is None:
                    assert remaining is None and fresh is None and policy['result']=='NOT_ENTERED'
                else:
                    assert type(remaining) is int and 0<=remaining<=e['group_size']
                    assert type(fresh) is int and fresh>=0
                if policy['result']=='SKIPPED_ACCEPTANCE_INELIGIBLE':
                    assert e['repair_attempt_id'] is not None and e['fresh_paths']==e['group_size']
                    reason='REMAINING_AGENTS' if remaining!=0 else 'COST_EXCEEDS_OLD' if fresh>e['old_subset_soc'] else None
                    assert reason is not None and policy['skip_reason']==reason
                    assert not e['candidate_validated'] and e['candidate_subset_soc'] is None and e['candidate_reward'] is None
                    assert not e['accepted'] and e['committed_gain']==0
                    assert not e['censored']
                    assert d['validation_result']==policy['result'] and d['validation_last_stage']=='ACCEPTANCE_GATE'
                    for clock in ('wall','cpu'):
                        assert d['candidate_materialization_'+clock+'_ns']==d['candidate_joint_check_'+clock+'_ns']==0
                    hist['gate_reason'][reason]+=1; totals['skipped_acceptance_ineligible']+=1
                else:
                    assert policy['skip_reason']=='NONE'
                    if e['candidate_validated']:
                        assert policy['result']=='VALIDATED' and remaining==0 and fresh<=e['old_subset_soc'] and fresh==e['candidate_subset_soc']
                    elif e['repair_attempt_id'] is not None and e['fresh_paths']==e['group_size']:
                        assert policy['result']=='DEADLINE' and e['censored']
                    else:
                        assert policy['result']==('INCOMPLETE_SKIPPED' if e['repair_attempt_id'] is not None else 'NOT_ENTERED')
            totals['committed_gain']+=e['committed_gain']; totals['accepted']+=int(e['accepted'])
            totals['censored']+=int(e['censored']); totals['selections']+=1
            if e['candidate_validated']:
                assert e['candidate_reward']==e['old_subset_soc']-e['candidate_subset_soc']
            else:
                assert e['candidate_reward'] is None and e['candidate_subset_soc'] is None
            if e['accepted']:
                assert e['candidate_validated'] and e['candidate_reward']==e['committed_gain']
            if d['search_loop_exit_stop']=='COST_STOP':
                assert not e['accepted'] and e['committed_gain']==0 and d['remaining_at_search_return']>0
                assert not e['candidate_validated'] or e['candidate_reward']<=0
                totals['cost_stop_count']+=1
                totals['cost_stop_validation_entered']+=int(d['validation_entered'])
                totals['cost_stop_validated']+=int(e['candidate_validated'])
                totals['cost_stop_validation_wall_ns']+=d['candidate_validation_wall_ns']
                totals['cost_stop_selection_wall_ns']+=e['selection_wall_before_log_ns']
                hist['cost_stop_candidate_reward'][str(e['candidate_reward'])]+=1
                hist['cost_stop_first_stage'][first['stage'] if first else 'NONE']+=1
            if e['candidate_validated'] and e['candidate_reward']<=0:
                totals['validated_nonpositive_count']+=1
                totals['validated_nonpositive_validation_wall_ns']+=d['candidate_validation_wall_ns']
            if e['accepted']: totals['accepted_validation_wall_ns']+=d['candidate_validation_wall_ns']
        assert previous==final_soc and totals['committed_gain']==initial_soc-final_soc
        assert len(events)==native['group_calls']==native['reward_contract']['selections']==native['reward_contract']['settlements']
        assert arms==native['reward_contract']['arms']
        assert native['reward_contract']['memory']=='author' and native['reward_contract']['posterior_rule']=='AUTHOR_ATTEMPT_BEFORE_ROLLBACK'
        assert native['reward_contract']['log_wall_ns']>=0 and native['reward_contract']['log_cpu_ns']>=0
        if job['candidate_validation_policy']=='all':
            assert 'candidate_validation_policy' not in native['reward_contract']
        else:
            assert native['reward_contract']['candidate_validation_policy']==dict(schema='ADDRESS_CANDIDATE_VALIDATION_V1',mode='acceptance_eligible',skipped_acceptance_ineligible=totals['skipped_acceptance_ineligible'])
        assert repairs==native['repair_attempts']==result['reward_diagnostics']['repairs']
        assert dict(hist['outcome'])==result['reward_diagnostics']['outcomes']
        for key,value in native['reward_contract']['cost_diagnostics'].items():
            if key!='schema': assert totals[key]==value
        diag=result['reward_diagnostics']['cost_diagnostics']
        assert dict(hist['first_stage'])==diag['first_observed_deadline_stage_counts']
        assert dict(hist['pool'])==diag['completed_eligible_topk_size_counts']
        assert dict(hist['validation_result'])==diag['validation_result_counts']
        family=job['case'].split('__')[0]
        family_data=families.setdefault(family,{'totals':Counter(),'hist':{k:Counter() for k in hist}})
        family_data['totals'].update(totals)
        for key in hist: family_data['hist'][key].update(hist[key])
        per_job.append({'job':job['id'],'case':job['case'],'policy':job['candidate_validation_policy'],'status':'COMPLETE','initial_soc':initial_soc,'final_soc':final_soc,'initial_makespan':initial_makespan,'final_makespan':final_makespan,
            'entry_wall_ns':rec['total_entry_through_output_validation_and_hash_ns'],'outer_wall_ns':outer_row['outer_command_wall_ns'],
            'worker_cpu_ns':result['worker_cpu_ns'],'native_cpu_s':native['inner_cpu_s'],'largest_child_maxrss_kib':rec['costs']['largest_child_maxrss_kib'],
            'stage_wall_ns':result['stage_wall_ns'],'supervisor_costs':rec['costs'],'supervisor_self_cpu_s':rec['supervisor_self_cpu_s'],
            'native_inner_wall_before_receipt_s':native['inner_wall_before_receipt_s'],'native_initial_check_s':native['initial_check_s'],'native_final_check_s':native['final_check_s'],
            'native_termination':native['termination'],'native_loop_exit_reason':native['loop_exit_reason'],'sipp_calls':native['sipp_calls'],'repair_attempts':repairs,
            'reward_trace_bytes':reward_trace_bytes,
            'maximum_observed_group_size':max(e['group_size'] for e in events),
            'group_size_above_documented_eight':[dict(selection_id=e['selection_id'],group_size=e['group_size']) for e in events if e['group_size']>8],
            'reward_log_wall_ns':native['reward_contract']['log_wall_ns'],'reward_log_cpu_ns':native['reward_contract']['log_cpu_ns'],
            'totals':dict(totals),'hist':{k:dict(v) for k,v in hist.items()},
            'validation_share_of_selection':totals['candidate_validation_wall_ns']/totals['selection_wall_ns'],
            'materialization_share_of_selection':totals['candidate_materialization_wall_ns']/totals['selection_wall_ns'],
            'joint_check_share_of_selection':totals['candidate_joint_check_wall_ns']/totals['selection_wall_ns'],
            'validation_share_of_admission':totals['candidate_validation_wall_ns']/rec['total_entry_through_output_validation_and_hash_ns'],
            'cost_stop_share_of_validation':totals['cost_stop_validation_wall_ns']/totals['candidate_validation_wall_ns']})
    aggregated={}
    for family,data in families.items():
        t=data['totals']; aggregated[family]={'totals':dict(t),'hist':{k:dict(v) for k,v in data['hist'].items()},
            'validation_share_of_selection':t['candidate_validation_wall_ns']/t['selection_wall_ns'],
            'cost_stop_share_of_validation':t['cost_stop_validation_wall_ns']/t['candidate_validation_wall_ns'],
            'cost_stop_validation_share_of_selection':t['cost_stop_validation_wall_ns']/t['selection_wall_ns']}
    paired=[]
    for first,second in zip(per_job[::2],per_job[1::2]):
        assert first['case']==second['case'] and first['policy']=='all' and second['policy']=='acceptance_eligible'
        paired.append(dict(case=first['case'],soc_first_minus_second=first['final_soc']-second['final_soc'],makespan_first_minus_second=first['final_makespan']-second['final_makespan'],first=first['job'],second=second['job']))
        events_a,event_b=event_sets[first['job']],event_sets[second['job']]
        fields=('seed_id','group_size','fresh_paths','stop','outcome','censored','candidate_validated','candidate_reward','committed_gain','committed_task_soc')
        differences={}
        for field in fields:
            pair=next(((a,b) for a,b in zip(events_a,event_b) if a[field]!=b[field]),None)
            differences[field]=(dict(selection_id=pair[0]['selection_id'],all_value=pair[0][field],gated_value=pair[1][field]) if pair else None)
        first_seed_diff=differences['seed_id']
        paired[-1]['descriptive_first_field_differences']=differences
        paired[-1]['same_seed_prefix_selections']=first_seed_diff['selection_id']-1 if first_seed_diff else min(len(events_a),len(event_b))
        paired[-1]['total_admission_gated_minus_all_ns']=second['entry_wall_ns']-first['entry_wall_ns']
        paired[-1]['candidate_validation_all_minus_gated_ns']=first['totals']['candidate_validation_wall_ns']-second['totals']['candidate_validation_wall_ns']
        paired[-1]['descriptive_only_no_counterfactual_or_causal_attribution']=True
    for computed,saved in zip(paired,receipt['paired_contrasts']):
        assert computed['case']==saved['case'] and computed['soc_first_minus_second']==saved['soc_first_minus_second'] and computed['makespan_first_minus_second']==saved['makespan_first_minus_second']
        assert saved['both_complete']
    protocol_deviation=dict(status='DEVIATION_DOCUMENTED_NEIGHBORHOOD_CAP',original_claim='邻域上限8',
        original_checklist_scientific_commit=receipt['scientific_code_commit'],original_checklist_sha256=sha(original_checklist),
        manifest_has_separate_actual_neighborhood_hard_cap=False,author_source_sha256=source_pins,
        source_explanation='Pinned author randomWalk can add both vertex and edge conflicting agents in one getConflictingAgents call before testing size>=neighbor_size; generateNeighborByRandomWalk assigns the full set without a final resize. Eight is the configured target, not a certified hard cap.',
        affected_records={p['job']:p['group_size_above_documented_eight'] for p in per_job},
        original_receipt_unchanged=True,scope='Path/ledger/resource checks pass; full written-protocol conformance must not be claimed.')
    return {'schema':'INDEPENDENT_READONLY_VALIDATION_GATE_AUDIT_V1','status':'PASS_WITH_PROTOCOL_DEVIATION','source_receipt_sha256':EXPECTED,'manifest_sha256':MANIFEST,
        'input_sha256':cfg['input_sha256'],'scientific_code_commit':receipt['scientific_code_commit'],'original_batch_artifacts_verified':len(receipt['artifacts']),
        'per_job_artifact_pins_verified':total_pin_count,'events_verified':total_events,'full_initial_and_final_discrete_plans_independently_validated':8,
        'author_final_paths_equal_result_json':True,'new_search':False,'reruns':0,'counts':receipt['counts'],'per_job':per_job,'aggregated':aggregated,'paired_contrasts':paired,
        'authorization_consumed_or_closed':True,'sum_outer_command_wall_ns':sum(r['outer_command_wall_ns'] for r in outer['records']),
        'component_checks':dict(discrete_initial_final_plans='PASS',byte_pins='PASS',once_only_reward_and_gate_ledger='PASS',recorded_resource_costs='PASS'),
        'protocol_deviation':protocol_deviation,
        'limitations':['Two known design tasks and one solver seed each, not independent or generalized performance evidence.','This audit verifies discrete grid paths, not continuous robot-body motion.','Validation is nested in post-search and selection; timings cannot be added.','First observed cutoff checkpoint is not the true crossing instant.','Same total budget allows different work; more repairs do not establish better final quality or fixed-work speedup.','Candidate eligibility/clock changes may alter censor labels and future random sequence; no trajectory or posterior equivalence is claimed.','Author arm summary audits committed outcomes, not its original posterior.','Skipped candidate reward stays unknown; actual committed reward zero is audited separately.']}
